participants.name: GEEHUB Dropbox corpus
observations: Top-level folder listing completed
Observed folders include AI, artifacts, chapters, worlds, production, state, _engine, Creations, maps, assets, characters, experiments, and corpus
Observed source files include growth_comission.mov and a WebP reference image
The /GEEHUB/corpus folder was inspected and returned no immediate children.
The /GEEHUB/AI folder contains three Paper documents: GEEHUB AI Build 0.1, Coach: The Presence Charter, and Live Wand Session 001.
The AI build document specifies a Tractus/Wand/runtime architecture but explicitly states that its proposed source tree has not yet been created.
The Live Wand Session records supervised conversational execution and a simulated ledger, not a deployed service.
The /GEEHUB/characters folder contains Dima Romanov — Physique Study.paper; its text records visual observations and explicitly leaves measurements unestablished.

honesty_rule: A successful read proves only the access that was exercised. A listed affordance is not proof that it has been executed. Never promote imagined, permission-dependent, or unimplemented capabilities to verified status.
